  1. Must see · Malacca

    A Famosa & Dutch Square (Jonker Street)

    The 1511 Portuguese fort gate (Porta de Santiago), the red Dutch Stadthuys/Christ Church and Jonker Street — the heart of UNESCO Malacca.

    Look for UNESCO colonial heritage

    Bandar Hilir, Malacca (Melaka), Malaysia

    Recommended by UNESCO World Heritage, Wikipedia

  2. Worth the detour · Hainanese Chicken Rice · Malacca

    Chung Wah Chicken Rice Ball

    The long-queued Jonker Street original of Malacca's signature rice-ball chicken rice, at the entrance to Jonker Walk; documented by Mark Wiens and in the MICHELIN Guide's chicken-rice feature.

    18 Jalan Hang Jebat (Jonker Street), Malacca, Malaysia

    Recommended by Mark Wiens / Migrationology, Michelin Guide
